notes: «ح» splits two branches; «كلاهما عن أيوب» meets them, so the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3)
«وقد سمعته من، عقبة ولكني لحديث عبيد أحفظ» is the transmitter's remark on his own hearing, same last link, not a route; «فذكر معناه» is wording; Hammad's remark after the matn is not a route
